original_metadata.cve_description: A vulnerability was found in lsfusion platform up to 6.1. Affected is the function DownloadFileRequestHandler of the file web-client/src/main/java/lsfusion/http/controller/file/DownloadFileRequestHandler.java. Performing manipulation of the argument Version results in path traversal. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit has been made public and could be used.
